description:
Location: San Francisco, CA (Onsite)
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Compensation: $160,000–$240,000 Base Salary + Equity
 
 About the Opportunity
 We are supporting our client, an early-stage technology company developing AI-powered solutions to modernize complex operational workflows.
 The organization is building technology that enables businesses to automate critical processes, integrate disconnected systems, and improve operational efficiency. Its solutions address challenges in industries that have traditionally relied on legacy software, spreadsheets, and manual processes.
 They are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer to work directly with enterprise customers, understand their technical and operational challenges, and design and implement tailored solutions.
 This is an opportunity for a hands-on engineer who enjoys solving real-world problems, working closely with customers, and taking ownership of projects from initial concept through production deployment.
 
 Key Responsibilities
 Own the full technical lifecycle of customer implementations, including solution architecture, development, deployment, and ongoing optimization.
 Partner with customer executives, technical teams, and business stakeholders to understand operational challenges and translate requirements into effective technical solutions.
 Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered workflows, software integrations, and custom features that address customer needs.
 Build a deep understanding of the underlying technology platform and leverage its capabilities to deliver tailored implementations.
 Develop scalable, reliable solutions that integrate with existing customer systems and business processes.
 Collaborate with internal product, engineering, and sales teams to communicate customer requirements, identify product improvements, and influence technical priorities.
 Troubleshoot technical issues, provide hands-on implementation support, and ensure the reliability of deployed solutions.
 Rapidly prototype, test, and iterate on technical solutions based on customer feedback.
 Work directly with customers throughout implementation to ensure successful adoption and long-term performance.
 Requirements 
 Strong software engineering skills, with the ability to read, write, and troubleshoot production code.
 Proficiency in Python, Node.js, and Next.js , along with a solid understanding of data-driven application architectures.
 Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering, implementation engineering, or a similar position.
 Strong communication and relationship-building skills, particularly when working with enterprise or B2B customers.
 Demonstrated ability to understand complex business challenges and translate them into practical technical solutions.
 Strong problem-solving abilities and comfort working in fast-paced, evolving technical environments.
 Interest in logistics, operational technology, or related industries, with a willingness to develop deeper domain expertise.
 Ability to independently manage technical priorities and take ownership of customer-facing projects.
 
 Preferred Qualifications
 Experience delivering technical solutions directly to enterprise customers.
 Background in rapid prototyping, iterative software development, or custom implementation projects.
 Familiarity with logistics, supply chain, or operational workflows.
 Experience integrating software platforms with existing enterprise systems.
 Previous experience in an early-stage startup or similarly fast-paced engineering environment.
 
 Why Join?
 Work on emerging AI technology designed to transform complex business operations.
 Take ownership of meaningful, customer-facing engineering projects from design through deployment.
 Collaborate closely with a small, highly technical team and contribute to product development and innovation.
 Gain exposure to challenging operational problems across enterprise environments.
 Work directly with customers and industry experts to develop practical, high-impact solutions.
 Participate in customer-site visits and industry events, with opportunities to travel.
 Benefits 
 Compensation & Benefits
 Base salary: $160,000–$240,000 annually
 Equity participation
 Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance
 Daily meals provided
 Travel stipend
 Onsite work environment in San Francisco
 
 Interview Process
 The hiring process includes:
 Initial technical discussion with company leadership.
 Take-home technical assessment.
 In-person interviews with the engineering team.
 Potential short-term paid trial to evaluate mutual fit.
 
 Equal Opportunity
 Our client is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to qualified candidates. Hiring decisions are based on relevant qualifications, skills, and experience.
